title: Shah Zaadi Fatima Maa Nansa Hussaina
body:
Shah Zaadi Fatima Maa Nansa Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
abadwalla Ya Zahra Maa Nansa Hussaina
01. Karbal Me Jo Hussain Ko Paani Nahi Mila
zahra Ke Noor E Ain Ka Pyaasa Gala Kata
daryaao Ne Kaha Maa Nansa Hussaina
02. Paida Huwe Hussain Ke Matam Ke Waste
marjayenge Hussain Tere Gham Ke Waste
<<MINI>>
shah Zaadi Fatima Maa Nansa Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
03. Jab Tak Jiye Hussain Ka Matam Karenge Ham
matam Me Jaan Shaah Pe Wara Karenge Ham
matam Ki Hai Sada Maa Nansa Hussaina
04. Matam Karo Hussain Ka Jab Tak Ye Jaan Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye Matam E Hussain To Momin Ki Shaan Hai
waada Hai Rooh Ka Maa Nansa Hussaina
05. Ye Tera Jaanisaar Bhi Matam Shiyar Hai
dawar Bhi Tere Sog Me Seena Figaar Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aye Kushtaye Jafaa Maa Nansa Hussaina
